paragraphs: Neḥemyah son of Rav Huna bar Ḥanilai. I did not find Rav Huna bar Ḥanilai. Eruvin 43b has R. Neḥemyah son of Rav Ḥanilai go beyond the Sabbath boundary. R. Ḥisda told Rav Naḥman, 'Your student Neḥemyah is in distress.' He answered, 'Make a partition of people, and let him enter.'
